proposal.name: pyjwt
proposal.rationale: Version 2.13.0 is the most likely version based on: (1) it exists in pypi registry (E1), (2) it was available before the SBOM timestamp and has the highest prior probability (0.522) among versions satisfying the >=2.13 constraint (E2), and (3) it is a valid release with declared dependencies (E3). The SBOM's current candidates also show 2.13.0 with the highest probability (0.7).
